Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Gaston
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 275 as introduced would eliminate: (1) the requirement to publish the Administrative Code in loose-leaf format, which would decrease the postage and printing costs of the Legislative Services Agency (LSA) by approximately $5500, and (2) the subscription charge for the Alabama Administrative Code and the Alabama Administrative Monthly, which would decrease receipts to LSA by an estimated $4,740 annually.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
